objective: Acquire and audit only the official CT-RATE ts_total masks corresponding to the ReXGroundingCT MICCAI validation cohort before any downstream use.

population.evaluation_order_policy: retain separately from metadata order and join results only by name

repository_pins.execution_policy: authenticate to both gated repositories, re-query exact paths at these immutable revisions, and write a runtime source lock before any transfer

inputs.local_ct_contract: existing native CT-RATE fixed volumes only; do not move, rewrite, or resample them
inputs.downloaded_ct_rate_data_contract: official source NIfTIs remain unchanged after validation

preflight.local_ct_provenance: compute local SHA-256 and compare it with the pinned CT-RATE remote-object metadata when available
preflight.approval_gate: print the resolved count, byte total, and first ten private manifest rows; require an explicit approval of the manifest SHA-256 before download

runtime.policy: all raw masks, derived masks, visualizations, logs, and case-level manifests remain under this external runtime root

execution_environment.policy: run NIfTI integrity, geometry, lung QC, and visual-QC stages in this locally pinned image; record package versions at runtime

download.method: revision-pinned targeted huggingface_hub download followed by staged full validation and atomic promotion

allowed_only_if: CT and segmentation each have the same coded qform matrix and code
both qforms agree with their respective best affine
the CT coded sform agrees with its best affine
the segmentation sform is specifically unset (code 0), not conflicting
shape, index grid, world affine, spacing, units, provenance, and labels all pass
qc_only_compatible_exception.scope: QC-only native lung derivation; record the sform absence explicitly

header_metadata_policy.all_other_qform_sform_disagreements: quarantine and report; never resample or derive lungs

geometry_audit.mismatch_policy: quarantine and report; this audit never authorizes automatic resampling

segmentation_qc.visual_qc_selection: all exceptions plus a deterministic representative sample

lut_provenance_gate.required_evidence: CT-RATE-producer versioned total-task mapping with immutable source and hash
forbidden_fallbacks: current local TotalSegmentator mapping without CT-RATE producer provenance
lut_provenance_gate.when_blocked: do not validate allowed anatomy IDs conclusively, derive left/right lungs, or claim a final PASS

tracked: small provenance summary without case identifiers
